title: The Agnostic
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|q_where = id="the_agnostic_keystone2695"}}

'''The Agnostic''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that removes your [[energy shield]] and drains [[mana]] per second to recover your [[life]] while you are not at [[full life]].

This skill node is essential for the [[Mana before Life]] defensive technique, provided you have enough Mana recovery to maintain it.

==Mechanics==
"Full Life" is used in the literal sense, rather than the "no Life left to recover" sense used by [[flask]]s. If you have any Life reserved, you will sacrifice Mana continuously even if your unreserved Life is full. Forcing the full life condition (i.e. {{il|Coward's Chains}}) does not change this behavior, but the {{c|mod|You count as on Full Life while at 90% of maximum Life or above}} [[Life Mastery]] will change the life threshold for when The Agnostic activates.

While at full life and taking damage over time, the mana sacrificed will be equal to the total life lost per second, up to the maximum of 20% of your mana<ref>{{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=July 15, 2019|title=Why doesn't The Agnostic interact with DoTs in the same way as every other Full Life effect?|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/cd1ys7/comment/ett5c9g/}}</ref>.

Life Recovery Rate will affect the recovery of the Agnostic Keystone, but it will not affect the loss of mana at all<ref>{{cite web|author=Community_Team|date=May 19, 2021|title=Game Mechanics Q&A Answers|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3123794}}</ref>.

==Location==
The Agnostic is located on the far left side of the skill tree, to the west of the Templar's starting point.
